correctness.rationale: Exact nonreset Laplace transforms with three boundary types give the mean identity. Hyperbolic reduction yields one derivative polynomial with exactly one positive root; its endpoint signs and a factored midpoint-versus-boundary difference prove every global and local phase boundary. The one-sided reset survival transforms have unique simple principal poles by positivity of a compact killed diffusion; coupling monotonicity orders the pole across reset sites. The doubly killed mode decays strictly faster, preventing cancellation in inclusion–exclusion. Fifty-three stand-alone discretization and eigenvalue checks passed; computations are supplementary, not proof.

value.rationale: Fixed-rate reset placement is a meaningful controllable parameter in exhaustive endpoint coverage. The discontinuous location switch, a distinct metastability threshold, and the uniquely midpoint-optimal rare-delay exponent rigorously explain why mean-optimal designs can be poor against rare catastrophic delays. The theorem classifies all positive rates and all reset locations and gives actionable dimensionless thresholds.
